title: Arrears Worksheet: Amount of a Catch-Up Payment
content:
Patient Financial Services arrears worksheet for **Patient Payment Plans**: the amount of the catch-up payment on a past-due plan.

## The rule

An extra-principal payment posted on the plan ledger against the latest missed installment, carrying that installment's number, counts toward the catch-up payment as this rule sets out, even where it is smaller than an installment; an extra-principal payment carrying no installment number reduces the balance without moving the schedule and never counts toward the catch-up payment.

The catch-up payment is the amounts of every installment recorded missed on the plan ledger, less every arrears payment already posted on the plan ledger, less the catch-up credit, and it is never less than the catch-up minimum, which is one full regular installment of the plan; when the amount worked out is lower, the catch-up payment is the catch-up minimum.

The catch-up credit is one half (50 percent) of all the extra-principal payments posted against the latest missed installment, but never more than one quarter (25 percent) of the regular installment.

The catch-up credit is worked out first and the cap on it applied, the missed amounts less the arrears payments less the credit are worked out next, and the catch-up minimum is compared with that result; every amount is taken to the nearest cent, an exact half cent being rounded up.

## Terms used

- **Latest missed installment** — the installment named on the plan's most recent missed-installment line.
- **Regular installment** — the regular monthly installment standing on the plan.
- **Missed amounts** — the amounts on every missed-installment line of the plan ledger, all of them added together.
- **Arrears payments** — every payment on the plan ledger posted as an arrears payment, all of them added together.

## Worksheet order

1. One half of the extra-principal payments carrying the latest missed installment's number, to the cent.
2. One quarter of the regular installment, to the cent; the catch-up credit is the lower of lines 1 and 2.
3. Missed amounts, less arrears payments, less the catch-up credit, to the cent.
4. The catch-up minimum: one full regular installment, to the cent.
5. The catch-up payment is the higher of lines 3 and 4.

## Worked figures (hypothetical plan)

Regular installment 120.00. Missed-installment lines for installments 5 and 6, at 120.00 each. One arrears payment of 40.00 already posted. Extra-principal payments carrying number 6 of 30.00 and 25.00, and one extra-principal payment of 50.00 carrying no installment number.

| Line | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | one half of 30.00 and 25.00 together (55.00) | 27.50 |
| 2 | one quarter of 120.00 | 30.00 |
| Credit | lower of 27.50 and 30.00 | 27.50 |
| 3 | 240.00 less 40.00 less 27.50 | 172.50 |
| 4 | one full installment | 120.00 |
| Payment | higher of 172.50 and 120.00 | **172.50** |

The 50.00 payment with no installment number is not counted.

**Same plan, cap reached.** If the extra-principal payments carrying number 6 totalled 80.00, line 1 would be 40.00, the credit would be held at 30.00, and line 3 would be 240.00 less 40.00 less 30.00, that is 170.00; the payment would be 170.00.

**Same plan, minimum reached.** If 150.00 of arrears payments had already been posted, line 3 would be 240.00 less 150.00 less 27.50, that is 62.50; being lower than 120.00, the catch-up payment would be 120.00.
